# Distraction Blocker

> Distraction Blocker is a free Windows 10 and Windows 11 app that runs Pomodoro focus sessions and blocks distracting apps and websites. Once a focus session starts it cannot be turned off, paused, or uninstalled until the PC restarts — which makes it effective both for personal focus and as free parental-control software for kids' study time. There is no account, no subscription, and no data leaves the device.

## Pages
- [Home / focus app](https://distraction-blocker.com/): Overview, how it works, features, FAQ, and download.
- [Parental Control](https://distraction-blocker.com/parental-control.html): How to use Distraction Blocker as free parental-control software — block games, apps, and websites during study time with no bypass until restart.
- [Privacy Policy](https://distraction-blocker.com/privacy.html): What data is and isn't collected (privacy-friendly, no cookies).

## Key facts
- Platform: Windows 10 and Windows 11
- Price: Free — no subscription, no account, no credit card
- Core feature: focus sessions that block chosen apps and websites and cannot be disabled until the PC restarts
- Breaks: apps and websites unlock automatically during scheduled breaks
- Privacy: no account, no in-app analytics, block lists and settings stay on the device
- Download: https://github.com/stefansujdovic/Distraction-Blocker-Landing-Page/releases/latest/download/DistractionBlockerSetup.exe
- Contact: stefansujdovic@gmail.com
